nodes.label: setest master/devel Test Protocol
nodes.rationale: Testing workflow with git: master is the released branch, 'devel' holds corrections; 'make text.exp' on master builds setest statically linked with SE and creates expectation values setest/t.exp, then 'make test' on devel checks against them. Developed by Dieter Koch with Ruediger Plantiko, maintained by Alois Treindl since July 2021.
